title: Understanding LASSO Regression
text: LASSO regression is useful when you want to perform feature selection by shrinking some coefficients to zero.

title: Why Use LASSO?
text: LASSO regression helps in reducing overfitting by penalizing the absolute size of the coefficients.

hintAnswer: Use LASSO regression to predict Y from X.
title: Choosing the Right Model
text: Which regression technique is known for setting some feature weights to zero, effectively performing feature selection?
choices: Use OLS to predict Y from X.
Use LASSO regression to predict Y from X.
Use ridge regression to predict Y from X.
Use a constant model to predict Y from X.
